claims: An overloaded extension cord carries more electrical current than its wire gauge is designed to handle.
This excess current generates excessive heat due to electrical resistance.
The continuous high heat causes the plastic insulation and casing to melt.

claims.text: Overloading can cause an extension cord to heat up to the point that its insulation either melts or carbonizes.
